name: Kanzaki Dengorou
source:
[b]“Moe is nothing but my cute, sexy, and beautiful kitten!”[/b]

Dengorou is Moe’s grandfather, and a master of the ancient martial art called the Kanzaki Style. He surpasses Moe in skill greatly, but the years are starting to get to him. He’s hard with everyone around him and himself, but he has a very sweet spot for Moe. 

Seeing Kaito become friendly with Moe rubs him the wrong way.

Hobbies:  He’s wholeheartedly devoted to his martial arts training
Likes: Dengorou loves to fight with other people.
Dislikes: People that lack guts, and men that get too close to his granddaughter Moe.

[From [url=https://daybreaktl.wordpress.com/projectoverview/meet-the-characters]Daybreak Translations[/url]]
